Generates audited seccomp cBPF header files from symbolic policy expressions.

# Purpose
This file implements a small compiler that reads a seccomp policy file and generates a C header file with a `sock_filter` program. It parses policy lines, supports simple rules and EDN expressions, and emits cBPF instructions that check the runtime architecture, load the syscall number, and then branch to `SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW` or `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`. The generated header is written under a `generated/` directory and includes the needed Linux and project headers, plus an architecture check for `__i386__`, `__x86_64__`, or `__aarch64__`.

The main code path is built around [`codegen`](<#codegen>), [`expression`](<#expression>), and [`eval_`](<#eval_>), which translate policy syntax into BPF jump and load instructions. The file also defines helper classes such as `ReloCondJump`, `ReloJump`, and `CommentedLiteral` to store instructions before label relocation and to keep comments in the generated output. At the end of the script, the `__main__` block reads the source policy file, normalizes line layout, builds the filter body, and writes a C function named `populate_sock_filter_policy_<name>` plus a constant instruction count for use by other code.
